Carro da Polícia
programme.desc: Dois miúdos encontram um carro da polícia abandonado e decidem aprender a guiá-lo. Mas quando o corrupto xerife da cidade decide reavê-lo, os três envolvem-se numa corrida eletrizante onde vale tudo.

programme.title: Psico II
programme.desc: Vinte e dois anos depois do famoso homicídio de Marion Crane, Norman Bater é considerado são e é libertado, regressando ao seu motel dilapidado. Mas quando os homicídios recomeçam, Norman percebe que uma velha amiga aguarda o seu regresso, a mãe!

programme.title: Os Bad Boys
programme.desc: Um lote de heroína avaliada em cerca de 100 milhões de dólares é roubado do próprio depósito da polícia. O caso será encarregue aos agentes Burnett (Martin Lawrence) e Lowery (Will Smith), uma dupla muito peculiar pelos métodos que utilizam.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Na sequência da morte do seu filho o chefe da polícia secreta de Chicago contrata um ex-agente para desmantelar a Mafia que opera naquela cidade.

programme.title: Confiança
programme.desc: A vida de Jake Vig pode depender do que não sabe. Este elegante jogador acaba de roubar milhares de dólares ao intocável Lionel Dolby. No entanto, quando Lionel e outro membro da equipa aparecem mortos, descobre-se que Lionel não é um homem qualquer.

programme.title: Passageiros
programme.desc: Uma nave espacial transporta milhares de pessoas para um planeta colônia, que tem uma avaria em uma de suas câmaras de sono.

programme.title: Dead Man Down Um Homem A Abater
programme.desc: Victor é o braço direito de Alphonse, o líder de uma organização criminosa que está a ser perseguido por alguém que vai matando os membros do seu gangue e lhe envia notas ameaçadoras.

programme.title: Para Além do Horizonte
programme.desc: Chirs e Annie não conseguiram superar a morte dos seus dois filhos ocorrida num acidente de viação. Quatro anos depois Chris também morre e descobre que o Céu existe e que é um grande lugar.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo, hesita em acompanhar o velho amigo Coronel Trautman às linhas soviéticas no Afeganistão. Mas acabará por seguir, numa missão não-oficial de resgate na sequência da captura de Trautman.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: Jackie Brown é uma hospedeira de bordo que se vê envolvida num jogo de traições e vigarice com a autoria de Ordell Robbe, um aspirante a traficante de armas que quer "resgatar" meio milhão de dólares que apresenta nos seus cofres do México.

programme.title: Greenberg
programme.desc: Ben Stiller é Greenberg - solteiro, de quarenta e tal anos, que nada faz deliberadamente - nesta comédia inteligente, engraçada e comovente que os críticos dizem ser extremamente divertida.

programme.title: A História de Whitney Houston
programme.desc: Este retrato complexo da incomparável Whitney Houston acompanha a ascensão da cantora desde menina do coro em Nova Jérsia até estrela internacional.

programme.title: Olha que duas
programme.desc: Nesta aventura hilariante, uma sonhadora impetuosa (Amy Schumer) e a sua ultracautelosa mãe (Goldie Hawn) têm de trabalhar em equipa para sobreviver quando as suas férias sofrem uma reviravolta inesperada.

programme.title: Boyhood: Momentos De Uma Vida
programme.desc: Após o divórcio, uma mãe e um pai continuam a tarefa partilhada de educar o seu filho mais novo através da adolescência e, finalmente, até à idade adulta.

programme.title: A Ilha das Cabeças Cortadas
programme.desc: Morgan, uma bonita pirata que navega sob as ordens de seu pai, decide partir em busca de um fabuloso tesouro indicado num mapa que este lhe entregou antes de morrer.

programme.title: Misteriosa Obsessão
programme.desc: Telly Paretta é uma mulher que luta por superar a perda do seu filho de oito anos. Um dia, seu psicoterapeuta diz-lhe que o seu filho não é mais que um produto da sua imaginação.

programme.title: Psico III
programme.desc: Logo agora que pensávamos que era seguro voltar a entrar no duche! O terror regressa quando uma freira foragida (Diana Scarwid) com as mesmas iniciais de Marion Crane procura abriga no Motel Bates, espoletando o instinto assassino de Norman.

programme.title: Rapaz A
programme.desc: Jack Burridge, um assassino de crianças condenado, encontra trabalho como estafeta. Um jornal local descobre o seu passado, e Jack vê-se confrontado com a raiva e o medo dos habitantes pela segurança dos seus filhos.

programme.title: Cães Danados
programme.desc: Joe Cabot (Lawrence Tierney), um experiente criminoso, reuniu seis bandidos para um grande roubo de diamantes, mas estes seis homens não sabem nada um sobre os outros e cada um utiliza uma cor como codinome.

programme.title: Acordado
programme.desc: Clay Beresford, é um jovem milionário que aparenta ter tudo - dinheiro, uma lindíssima mulher e uma carreira lucrativa - mas, o que mais precisa é de fazer o transplante de coração que poderá salvar-lhe a vida.

programme.title: Poderia Acontecer-te
programme.desc: Charlie Lange é um policía de bom coração, casado com uma mulher ambiciosa. Certo dia, num café e sem dinheiro para pagar, promete algo à empregada de mesa, Yvonne. Se ganhar o próximo sorteio da lotaria, dá-lhe metade.

programme.title: Kiss & Kill - Beijos & Balas
programme.desc: Quando Jen Kornfeldt decide ceder aos caprichos dos seus pais, aceitando juntar-se a eles numa longa viagem pela costa francesa, não imaginava como a sua vida seria alterada.

programme.title: Oficina do Diabo
programme.desc: Neste thriller sinistro protagonizado por Emile Hirsch e Radha Mitchell, um ator pede a uma demonóloga para ajudá-lo a conseguir um papel, e o seu fim de semana juntos irrompe em violência ritual.

programme.title: Prisioneiro
programme.desc: Stallone enfrenta a cadeia e um inimigo especial que pretende matá-lo: Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: O Coleccionador de Ossos
programme.desc: Um diabólico assassino anda à solta nas ruas de Manhattan. Os seus brutais homicídios deixam um rasto de mensagens em código escondidas no local do crime, pistas que somente uma mente brilhante pode resolver.

programme.title: Máquinas De Guerra
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, uma experiência criou soldados invencíveis, a partir dos corpos de militares falecidos no terreno. Mas um dos soldados desumanizados tem recordações da sua vida anterior e irá escapar-se.

programme.title: Mare Vermelha
programme.desc: Depois do motim de uns rebeldes russos numa base com armamento nuclear, os Estados Unidos decidem enviar o submarino Alabama em missão de reconhecimento.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Expulso do FBI, Mark Kaminsky é contratado pelo xerife de uma pequena cidade para matar o assassino do filho. Mas, para isso, Kaminsky tem de se infiltrar nos meandros da Máfia de Chicago.

programme.title: Sleepers - Sentimento de Revolta
programme.desc: Depois de uma partida terminar em tragédia, quatro amigos são enviados para um centro correcional, onde são brutalizados. Dez anos depois, já em liberdade, têm a oportunidade de se vingarem de quem lhes fez mal.

programme.title: Oficina do Diabo
programme.desc: Neste thriller sinistro protagonizado por Emile Hirsch e Radha Mitchell, um ator pede a uma demonóloga para ajudá-lo a conseguir um papel, e o seu fim de semana juntos irrompe em violência ritual.

programme.title: A Ilha das Cabeças Cortadas
programme.desc: Morgan, uma bonita pirata que navega sob as ordens de seu pai, decide partir em busca de um fabuloso tesouro indicado num mapa que este lhe entregou antes de morrer.

programme.title: Psico III
programme.desc: Norman Bates apaixona-se por uma freira que esteve hospedada no Motel - o que deixa a sua "mãe" ciumenta - juntamente com um viajante e um jornalista curioso.

programme.title: O Universo no Olhar
programme.desc: Um biólogo molecular e o companheiro de laboratório descobrem evidências que podem alterar a sociedade tal como a conhecemos.

programme.title: Boyhood: Momentos de Uma Vida
programme.desc: Gravado ao longo de 12 anos, com o mesmo elenco, este projeto acompanha a vida do jovem Mason, dos seis aos 18 anos. Um miúdo como tantos outros que, aos poucos, emerge e segue o seu próprio caminho. Vencedor do Oscar® para Melhor Atriz Secundária em 2015.

programme.title: Chovem Almôndegas 2
programme.sub-title: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs 2
programme.desc: Flint Lockwood trabalha, agora, com o seu ídolo, Chester V, e os grandes inventores do Mundo. Tudo muda quando descobre que a máquina que transforma água em comida ainda funciona e está agora a criar animais-comida híbridos: os «comidimais»!

programme.title: Pompeia
programme.desc: Milo, um gladiador de Pompeia, tenta resgatar a amada de um casamento negociado pelos pais dela. Uma luta contra o tempo, ameaçada pela erupção do monte Vesúvio, que destrói Pompeia à sua passagem.

programme.title: Psicopata Americano
programme.desc: Patrick Bateman é um jovem bem sucedido em Wall Street, mas também um serial killer que vagueia livremente e sem receios, em busca de uma nova vítima. Uma mente tenebrosa, capaz dos mais sórdidos crimes, protegido pela conformidade, e pela riqueza.

programme.title: A Malta do Bairro
programme.desc: Este é um retrato social de alguns bairros de Los Angeles. A história acompanha a vida de três amigos do bairro, um que tenta sair dali para a Universidade, outro que vive envolto em violência e crime e um terceiro que tem um pai que o educa.

programme.title: Greenberg
programme.desc: Ben Stiller é Greenberg - solteiro, de quarenta e tal anos, que nada faz deliberadamente - nesta comédia inteligente, engraçada e comovente que os críticos dizem ser extremamente divertida.

programme.title: Acordado
programme.desc: Clay Beresford, é um jovem milionário que aparenta ter tudo - dinheiro, uma lindíssima mulher e uma carreira lucrativa - mas, o que mais precisa é de fazer o transplante de coração que poderá salvar-lhe a vida.

programme.title: Passageiros
programme.desc: Uma nave espacial, com destino a uma colónia distante, tem um problema nas câmaras de sono e dois passageiros acordam, 90 anos antes da chegada ao destino. Ameaçados pelo iminente colapso da nave, tentam descobrir o porquê de terem acordado.

programme.title: Olha Que Duas
programme.desc: Quando o namorado a deixa, antes das férias exóticas programadas, Emily Middleton convence a ultra cautelosa mãe a viajar com ela até ao paraíso. E o resultado é, no mínimo, inesperado...

programme.title: Na Linha de Fogo
programme.desc: Frank Horrigan, agente dos Serviços Secretos, é perseguido pela culpa de não ter conseguido evitar a morte de Kennedy, nos anos 60. Quando um assassino lunático lhe liga, a ameaçar de morte o atual Presidente dos EUA, Frank faz tudo para o proteger.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A hospedeira Jackie Brown concebe um plano audacioso para se apoderar de uma grande soma de dinheiro, que pertence a um poderoso traficante de armas.

programme.title: Sócios à Força
programme.desc: Nick Lang é uma famosa estrela de cinema que alia forças com um detetive nova-iorquino valentão, John Moss, para se emancipar da imagem de “bom rapaz” que cunhou no ecrã.

programme.title: O Massacre
programme.desc: Expulso do FBI, Mark Kaminsky é contratado pelo xerife de uma pequena cidade para matar o assassino do filho. Mas, para isso, Kaminsky tem de se infiltrar nos meandros da Máfia de Chicago.

programme.title: Hidalgo - O Grande Desafio
programme.desc: No deserto arábico, participar na corrida do Oceano de Fogo - um desafio à sobrevivência ao longo de milhares de quilómetros - sempre foi uma honra reservada para os melhores cavalos árabes. Em 1980, no entanto, o americano Frank T.

programme.title: Needle In a Timestack
programme.desc: Nick e Janine vivem felizes juntos, até que o ex-marido de Janine viaja no tempo para tentar separá-los. À medida que as memórias e a realidade de Nick desaparecem, ele terá de decidir o que está disposto a sacrificar para manter aquilo que ama.

programme.title: Hannibal
programme.desc: Hannibal Lecter refugia-se em Florença, onde passa a fazer parte da Junta de Conservadores do Palazzo Vecchio. Apesar de ter aprendido a controlar os instintos canibais, quando Hannibal é descoberto pelo inspetor Rinaldo Pazzi, a caçada começa...

programme.title: Kiss & Kill - Beijos & Balas
programme.desc: Quando Jen Kornfeldt decide ceder aos caprichos dos seus pais, aceitando juntar-se a eles numa longa viagem pela costa francesa, não imaginava como a sua vida seria alterada.

programme.title: A Minha Lancheira

programme.title: O Leonel das Moscas

programme.title: As Aventuras de Ladybug
programme.desc: Marinette e Adrien durante o dia são dois adolescentes normais com uma vida normal, mas há uma coisa sobre eles que ainda ninguém sabe: quando algo ameaça a cidade, Marinette e Adrien transformam-se em Ladybug e Cat Noir!

programme.title: Zoé e Milo
programme.desc: Zoe e Milo são duas crianças de dez anos. Eles não são apenas vizinhos que vivem numa cidade grande, são os melhores amigos. E também são aventureiros: viajam pelo mundo num avião construído e pilotado por Alim, um hamster.

programme.title: Index

programme.title: Europa à Porta

programme.title: Terra Europa

programme.title: Em Busca da Ressurreição

programme.title: O eclipse

Pistruiatul 2 - Ascunzișuri
programme.desc: Mihai, zis Pistruiatul, adaposteste un detinut politic evadat, care are nevoie de o locuinta conspirativa. Pistruiatul ia parte la misiune unde are surpriza sa-si intilneasca tatal si profesoara de istorie.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: Iancu Jianul, zapciul
Iancu Jianu, zapciul
programme.desc: Fiul de boier Iancu slujeşte cinstit domnia ca zapciu. Când haiducul Mereanu fură caravanele cu aur ale lui Caragea, asprul şi neîndurătorul Iancu se îngrijeşte ca nimeni să nu încalce legea.

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Focus 18
programme.desc: La Focus 18, cel mai important jurnal de ştiri, telespectatorii pot urmări, în fiecare zi, atât materiale în exclusivitate, cât şi rubrici dedicate sau reportaje speciale.

programme.title: Schimb de mame

programme.title: Cronica cârcotaşilor
programme.desc: Emisiunea Cronica cârcotaşilor prezintă o variantă unică a celor mai importante noutăţi din domeniul politic, social, cultural sau economic. Telespectatorii vor mai afla şi cum stau românii la capitolul cultură generală prin rubrica “Vocea Poporului”, iar “Top Ruşinică” face clasamentul binecunoscut al gafelor din televiziuni.

programme.title: Atunci i-am condamnat pe toți la moarte
programme.desc: Ipu (Amza Pellea), nebunul satului, traieste ultimele zile ale ocupatiei germane. El e apropiat de un baiat. Dupa ce un militar neamt e ucis, localnicii sunt amenintati cu executia daca nu-l predau pe vinovat. Ipu accepta sa-si asume crima.

programme.title: Caracatița
La piovra
programme.desc: Povestea lui Corrado Cattani, un inspector de poliţie ce şi-a dedicat viaţa luptei împotriva mafiei. Chiar şi când familia şi viaţa îi sunt grav puse în pericol de criminalii italieni, comisarul Corrado îndrăzneşte să continue lupta.

programme.title: Life & Style cu Maria Andrei
programme.desc: Emisiunea le propune telespectatorilor să redescopere destinații bine cunoscute, dar și rute alternative, să cunoască oameni deosebiți și să le afle poveștile, rețetele gastronomice și produsele locale premiate. Maria Andrei mai aduce în atenția publicului știri pertinente și autentice cu ajutorul unor specialiști respectați, și îi ajută să fie la curent cu ultimele tendințe în domeniul life & style.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Iancu Jianul, zapciul
Iancu Jianu, zapciul
programme.desc: Fiul de boier Iancu slujeşte cinstit domnia ca zapciu. Când haiducul Mereanu fură caravanele cu aur ale lui Caragea, asprul şi neîndurătorul Iancu se îngrijeşte ca nimeni să nu încalce legea.

programme.title: Pistruiatul 2 - Ascunzișuri
programme.desc: Mihai, zis Pistruiatul, adaposteste un detinut politic evadat, care are nevoie de o locuinta conspirativa. Pistruiatul ia parte la misiune unde are surpriza sa-si intilneasca tatal si profesoara de istorie.

programme.title: Cronica cârcotaşilor
programme.desc: Emisiunea Cronica cârcotaşilor prezintă o variantă unică a celor mai importante noutăţi din domeniul politic, social, cultural sau economic. programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May.

programme.title: Sick
programme.desc: Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think. Horror, starring Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million and Dylan Spradberry.

programme.title: The Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five students staying in a remote cabin find an ancient magical book, and unwittingly unleash evil spirits on the world. The dark forces they have conjured up possess them one by one, transforming them into ravenous zombies with an insatiable desire to feast on the living. Sam Raimi's horror, starring Bruce Campbell and Ellen Sandweiss.

programme.title: The Damned
programme.desc: A 19th-century widow must make an unimaginable choice when, during a cruel winter, a foreign ship sinks off the coast of her fishing village. Horror mystery, starring Odessa Young, Joe Cole, Siobhan Finneran and Rory McCann.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: A new girl who finds it difficult to fit in at school befriends three goth misfits, who discover they can perform magic and form a secret coven. They initially use their powers for self-improvement, but eventually start to turn against their classmates, driving the ringleader insane as her lust for power takes over. Horror, starring Robin Tunney, Fairuza Balk, Neve Campbell, Rachel True and Skeet Ulrich.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In 1930s Chicago, maverick scientist Dr Euphronius gives life to a murdered woman, sparking romance, police interest and radical change. Writer/director Maggie Gyllenhaal's horror based on The Bride of Frankenstein, starring Jessie Buckley, Christian Bale and Annette Bening.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Fifty-five years after her grandparents are involved in a disaster involving a restaurant tower, college student Stefani Reyes is plagued by recurring nightmares of the incident, and returns home seeking answers. The sixth entry in the supernatural horror saga, starring Kaitlyn Santa Juana, Teo Briones and Richard Harmon.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: In 1838 Germany, Thomas Hutter is sent to the Carpathian mountains to secure the signature of enigmatic nobleman Count Orlok on a property sale in the German city of Wisborg. Thomas leaves his bride Ellen in the care of friend Friedrich Harding and his wife Anna. The young man barely survives the exhausting trip to Europe and stumbles home to find Ellen driven to delirium by a telepathic bond to the Count. Director Robert Eggers' version of the Dracula-inspired horror, starring Bill Skarsgard, Lily-Rose Depp, Nicholas Hoult and Aaron Taylor-Johnson.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Decades since the rage virus took hold, the survivors live on a small island. When one of the group leaves on a mission into the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other survivors. Danny Boyle's horror thriller sequel, starring Jodie Comer, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ralph Fiennes and Rocco Haynes.

programme.title: Five Nights At Freddy's 2
programme.desc: One year after the supernatural nightmare at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, Mike and Vanessa are pulled back into a terrifying series of events. Horror sequel, starring Josh Hutcherson and Elizabeth Lail.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: An unambitious 29-year-old man recently dumped and trapped in the job from hell decides to get his life back on track. Unfortunately, he has to put his plans on hold when zombies rise from their graves and stalk the streets of London to feast on the living. Comedy horror, starring Simon Pegg, Nick Frost, Kate Ashfield, Dylan Moran, Lucy Davis, Bill Nighy and Penelope Wilton.

programme.title: Black Phone 2
programme.desc: Four years after a serial killer prowled the streets of North Denver, posing as a magician to lure unsuspecting children into the back of his van, teenager Finney tries to adjust to a normal life. However, the lethal Grabber returns, and is bent on revenge. Horror thriller, starring Ethan Hawke and Mason Thames.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: Five friends travel to a remote woodland cabin, hoping one of them can conquer her drug addiction by going cold turkey. They uncover a mysterious book that, when read, unleashes demonic forces that possess the living and transform them into bloodthirsty zombies. Horror remake, starring Jane Levy and Shiloh Fernandez.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon.

programme.title: Him
programme.desc: Cameron Cade is predicted to be the next great quarterback of American football. During a night-time training session, he suffers a traumatic brain injury. Cameron agrees to attend a week-long boot camp run by retiring star quarterback Isaiah White at his secluded desert compound. However, Cade's life soon turns into a nightmare. Supernatural horror, starring Marlon Wayans and Tyriq Withers.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: A science teacher's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town. Sci-fi comedy drama, starring Brandon Routh, Mena Suvari and Malina Pauli Weissman.

programme.title: The Accursed
programme.desc: A woman named Elly is asked by family friend Alma to look after an elderly lady living in a remote cabin for a few days. She agrees, but soon discovers there is a demon hiding in the woman, waiting to break free. Horror, starring Mena Suvari, Sarah Grey and Meg Foster.

programme.title: I Don't Understand You
programme.desc: Stranded in rural Italy, an American couple on the verge of adopting tries to reconnect during a disastrous vacation. Comedic horror, starring Nick Kroll, Andrew Rannells and Amanda Seyfried.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: A dull American town in the middle of the desert is suddenly attacked by huge man-eating subterranean creatures. Luckily, two dim-witted but brave handymen step into the breach to lead a ragtag bunch of locals and a mismatched pair of survivalists in the battle against the gruesome worm-like monsters. Comedy horror, with Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter, Michael Gross, Reba McEntire and Bobby Jacoby.

He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

While they're busy fighting over the land, the peace-minded Ross Haney (Zachary Scott) buys up all the water rights to the valley. But Haney's bid for order is disrupted by Doran (Dick Foran), a scheming third rancher, who supplies the warring parties with deadly gunfighters.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.title: NFL Matchup
programme.desc: An NFL Films production, "NFL Matchup" is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics -- the Xs and Os -- through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player and executive Louis Riddick and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio.

programme.title: Live: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

Alonzo actually has the use of his arms but keeps them concealed so that his true identity remains under wraps. Meanwhile, Alonzo falls in love with another performer, Nanon (Joan Crawford), who has a phobia against being touched by a man. But when the circus owner (Nick De Ruiz) discovers Alonzo's true identity, the performer makes a tragic decision.

programme.title: Day of Wrath
programme.desc: In a Danish village in the early 1600s, a young woman named Anne, whose mother was thought to be a witch, develops sympathy toward an old woman, Marte, who is accused of witchcraft. The intervention of Anne's older but kindly husband, Pastor Absalon saved her mother -- but now, urged on by his overbearing mother, he refuses to help Marte. When Absalon's son returns home and is attracted to Anne, it's a matter of time before her family destiny catches up with her.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Ordet
programme.desc: The three sons of devout Danish farmer Morten (Henrik Malberg) have widely disparate religious beliefs. Youngest son Anders (Cay Kristiansen) shares his father's religion, but eldest son Mikkel (Emil Hass Christensen) has lost his faith, while middle child Johannes (Preben Lerdorff Rye) has become delusional and proclaims that he is Jesus Christ himself. When Mikkel's wife, Inger (Birgitte Federspiel) goes into a difficult childbirth, everyone's beliefs are put to the test.

programme.title: Gold Rush Maisie
programme.desc: Driving along on her way to a gig at the Hula Parlor Café, Maisie Ravier (Ann Sothern) is stalled when she has engine troubles. She is forced to hitchhike into town, only to discover that the job's already been taken. On the upside, Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside the area and decides to go into business with the Davises, a family of poor prospectors, as well as Bill Anders (Lee Bowman), a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold.

programme.title: Maisie Gets Her Man
programme.desc: Chicago showgirl Maisie Ravier (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and begins a job working for Pappy (Allen Jenkins), a decent building manager. When she ends up getting them both fired, she lands a new position as an assistant to an aspiring comedian, Hap (Red Skelton). Hap's failings on stage, however, leave them in need of another job: working for a con man (Lloyd Corrigan) who bottles tap water. Eventually, Maisie and Hap fall for each other, but he still has a fiancée back home.

programme.title: The Barbarian
programme.desc: An Egyptian-American woman (Myrna Loy) runs around Cairo with a desert charmer (Ramon Novarro) who turns out to be a prince.

programme.title: When Ladies Meet
programme.desc: Reporter Jimmie Lee (Robert Montgomery) suspects his long-time girlfriend, successful novelist Mary Howard (Myrna Loy), of having a romance with her married publisher, Rogers Woodruf (Frank Morgan). While Mary works on her latest novel -- about a married woman allowing her husband to desert her for his mistress -- Jimmie meets Woodruf's wife, Clare (Ann Harding). Realizing she is unaware of her husband's affair, he convinces Clare to meet Mary while pretending to be his new girlfriend.

programme.title: Penthouse
programme.desc: After lawyer Jackson Durant (Warner Baxter) successfully defends racketeer Tony Gazotti (Nat Pendleton), Durant's fiancée, Sue (Martha Sleeper), leaves him. However, she soon needs his help when her new beau, Tom (Phillips Holmes), is accused of killing his old girlfriend (Mae Clarke). Durant takes the case, and, with the help of Gazotti and Gertie (Myrna Loy), the victim's roommate, he determines that crime boss Jim Crelliman (C. Henry Gordon) played a role in the murder.

programme.title: Night Flight
programme.desc: Pilots risk their lives by flying in dangerous weather through the Andes Mountains to deliver medicine to Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: The Prizefighter and the Lady
programme.desc: Steve (real-life boxer Max Baer) is a brash bartender whose knock-out power is discovered by the Professor (Walter Huston), an alcoholic ex-fight trainer. Working together, they find success in the ring, and Steve begins a whirlwind romance with the sultry Belle (Myrna Loy), a gangster's moll who hastily leaves her man to marry him. Steve's infidelity brings discord to their marriage, but he'll have to overcome these distractions if he's going to succeed in his heavyweight title fight.

programme.title: Men in White
programme.desc: Pressured by long hours filled with life-and-death decisions, medical intern George Ferguson (Clark Gable) grows increasingly exhausted and unsure about his career. After a night call forces him to break another date with fiancée Laura Hudson (Myrna Loy), George takes comfort with nursing student Barbara Dennin (Elizabeth Allan) -- unaware that his mentor, Dr. Hochberg (Jean Hersholt), knows of the liaison. Later, when confronted by Barbara's botched abortion, George must decide his future.

programme.title: Stamboul Quest
programme.desc: From within the confines of a mental institution, Annemarie (Myrna Loy) succumbs to memories of her rocky espionage career. As a German agent during World War I, Annemarie travels to Constantinople to gather information on a Turkish military official. Things go smoothly until she encounters an American medical student named Douglas (George Brent) while on her way to the Middle East. As the spy and the student fall in love, deadly consequences result.

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Fred, Al and Homer are three World War II veterans facing difficulties as they re-enter civilian life. Fred (Dana Andrews) is a war hero who, unable to compete with more highly skilled workers, has to return to his low-wage soda jerk job. Bank executive Al (Fredric March) gets into trouble for offering favorable loans to veterans. After losing both hands in the war, Homer (Harold Russell) returns to his loving fiancée, but must struggle to adjust.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: In the Salinas Valley of California, young Tom Tiflin lives on his family's ranch with his parents, Fred and Alice, who are constantly at odds, and with his rambling grandfather. Capturing Tom's admiration, however, is the hired ranch hand, Billy Buck, a venerable horse expert. When his father gives him a pony as a gift, Tom learns the importance of responsibility, but also has to face the pain of loss.

programme.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
programme.desc: When advertising executive Jim Blandings discovers his wife's plan to redecorate their New York apartment, he counters with a proposal that they move to Connecticut. She agrees, and the two are soon conned into buying a house that turns out to be a complete nightmare. Construction and repair bills accumulate quickly, and Jim worries that their future hangs in the balance unless he can come up with a catchy new jingle that will sell ham.

programme.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
programme.desc: Artist playboy Dickie Nugent (Cary Grant) appears before beautiful judge Margaret Turner (Myrna Loy) for fighting at a nightclub, and charms her into dismissing the charge. That same day, Dickie happens to lecture at a high school, where Margaret's teenage sister, Susan (Shirley Temple), falls head-over-heels for him. Things get complicated when Susan sneaks away and is found in Dickie's apartment, and downright zany when he is court ordered to date the teen as a way of easing her attraction.

programme.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
programme.desc: Uninterested in an office romance, successful fashion journalist Margot Sherwood Merrick (Myrna Loy) goes to great lengths to conceal the fact that she's single. To ward off potential beaus, including painter Jeff Thompson (Melvyn Douglas), she wears a fake wedding ring and tells everyone she already has a husband. When Jeff realizes that Margot doesn't have a spouse, he decides to make her pay for her deception by posing as her husband, leading to a comical rivalry and a surprising romance.

programme.title: So Goes My Love
programme.desc: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn.

programme.title: A Successful Calamity
programme.desc: After a year away in Europe, successful financier Henry Wilton (George Arliss) is finally returning home to his wife, Emmy (Mary Astor), daughter Peggy (Evalyn Knapp) and son Eddie, only to discover their lifestyle leaves them much too busy to spend any time together as a family. In a ploy to keep everyone together, Wilton lies about his wealth and announces he's financially ruined. As expected, his family rallies to support his supposed losses, but how long can he keep the charade up?

programme.title: Turn Back the Clock
programme.desc: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife.

programme.title: The Millionaire
programme.desc: Growing bored with life as a retiree, millionaire James Alden (George Arliss) secretly invests in an unprofitable gas station to amuse himself. Disguising himself and using the alias "Charles Miller," James begins a partnership with a young bootstrapper named Bill Merrick (David Manners). Complications arise when James' spoiled daughter, Barbara (Evalyn Knapp), becomes a regular customer and competition from a neighboring gas station threatens to ruin the business.

programme.title: Tycoon
programme.desc: American engineer Johnny Munroe (John Wayne) is hired by South American tycoon Frederick Alexander (Cedric Hardwicke) to bore a tunnel for a new railroad in the Andes Mountains. On the job, he falls for Alexander's beautiful daughter, Maura (Laraine Day). Facing dangerous conditions and serious design challenges, Munroe struggles to complete the job he was hired to do, while simultaneously struggling to convince his skeptical, overprotective employer that he is a worthy suitor for Maura.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Silver Dollar
programme.desc: Yates Martin (Edward G. Robinson) and his wife, Sarah (Aline MacMahon), are struggling to make ends meet as owners of a grocery store in late 19th-century Colorado. When Martin's silver mine strikes it rich, he begins to live the high life, moving to a huge mansion and running for public office. His grandiose ways alienate his wife, however, so he takes up with Lily (Bebe Daniels). Then Martin begins dreaming of running for national office, unaware that his fate will change once again.

programme.title: The World Changes
programme.desc: A young Midwesterner (Paul Muni) becomes a meat tycoon with a socialite wife (Mary Astor).

programme.title: Boom Town
programme.desc: Two rogue Texas oil men, Big John McMasters (Clark Gable) and Square John Sand (Spencer Tracy), drill oil wells in fields where there is no known oil. These wildcatters team up with a local drilling equipment owner, Luther Aldrich (Frank Morgan), and strike it rich -- but the ups and downs of the oil business, the whims of South American politics, and the love of Elizabeth Betsy Bartlett (Claudette Colbert) threaten to tear the two friends apart.

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage
programme.desc: Disfigured from wounds suffered in war, pilot Oliver Bradford (Robert Young) runs away in shame from his beautiful fiancée (Hillary Brooke) and his mother (Spring Byington). Renting a cottage from the kind-hearted Mrs. Minnett (Mildred Natwick), Oliver meets the plain-looking but gentle housekeeper Laura Pennington (Dorothy McGuire). As the veteran and the maid begin to learn more about one another, they see past their outer imperfections to discover that true beauty lies within.

programme.title: Desire Me
programme.desc: Soldiers Paul Aubert and Jean Renaud attempt to make their escape from a Nazi prison camp, but only Jean makes it out alive. When Jean is dispatched to deliver the sad news to Paul's wife, Marise, he begins a budding romance with the recently widowed woman. Then Paul, injured but still very much alive, sends word that he is coming to reunite with his wife, putting a damper on Jean's plans to start a new life with Marise.

programme.title: The Great Lie
programme.desc: After her long-time boyfriend, pilot Pete Van Allen (George Brent), marries fiery concert pianist Sandra Kovak (Mary Astor) while drunk, Maggie Patterson (Bette Davis) is heartbroken. Pete learns the marriage is illegal, yet dutifully offers to remarry Sandra. But when she refuses to alter a performance date to do so, Pete returns to Maggie and marries her. Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Paranormal researcher Abby Yates and physicist Erin Gilbert are trying to prove that ghosts exist in modern society. When strange apparitions appear in Manhattan, Gilbert and Yates turn to engineer Jillian Holtzmann for help. Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out. Armed with proton packs and plenty of attitude, the four women prepare for an epic battle as more than 1,000 mischievous ghouls descend on Times Square.

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered.

programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered.
